content: The execution was successful (Reward 1.0). The provided plan effectively handled the HWPX (ZIP/XML) manipulation by: 1) Unpacking the structure, 2) Identifying content XMLs, 3) Implementing a robust Python script to handle both JSON-based field replacements and CSV-based sequence updates, 4) Cleaning up layout cache (`lineSegArray`) to prevent rendering issues, and 5) Re-packing the archive. The heuristic approach for identifying follow-up paragraphs and the regex-based placeholder merging were key to handling potential XML fragmentation.
